premises.text: People often lose track of their good ideas across various file storage solutions.
premises.evidence_span: Have you ever had a really good idea and then lost it?

premises.text: A single platform is needed to consolidate and access all ideas and files.
premises.evidence_span: We just need one place where all of our ideas are at our fingertips.

premises.text: Docurated can discover and index files from multiple repositories.
premises.evidence_span: We ought to discover all of your files across any repository.

premises.text: Individual components of files can be extracted and used separately.
premises.evidence_span: We take every file that we find and we strip away the file formatting.

premises.text: Search results are ranked by relevance based on content and context.
premises.evidence_span: Relevance is determined both by the content and the context of the page.

premises.text: Docurated learns user preferences over time to improve search results.
Natural language processing eliminates the need for manual tagging of content.
premises.evidence_span: We will analyze your words. We will analyze your ideas.

premises.text: Users can create and export visual collages of their ideas from various file formats.
premises.evidence_span: Each page can be mashed up from any other page, from any other file format.

premises.text: Docurated is beneficial for both large enterprises and individual users.
premises.evidence_span: But we don't believe that Docurated only belongs to large enterprises.

value.text: Docurated provides a unified solution for managing and accessing ideas and information.
value.evidence_span: Docurated provides my team and I with the exact information we require.

notes: Customer testimonials and market size figures are excluded as traction.
